items.statement: No sensitive trade or settlement data may appear in application logs or telemetry emitted by this feature.
items.target: Zero occurrences of amount, counterparty identifier, or account number field values in logs/telemetry, verified by an automated log-content scan in CI on every build.

items.statement: Concurrent and retried resolution requests must not corrupt the audit trail.
items.target: A load test issuing 50 concurrent proposal attempts for the same exception identity results in exactly one accepted PROPOSED event and 49 conflict responses; a retried identical request with the same idempotency key never produces a second event.

items.statement: Compliance export must complete quickly enough to be usable interactively for typical regulatory response windows.
items.target: Export of a 100,000-event date range completes in under 30 seconds on reference hardware.

items.statement: The resolution workflow's state derivation and conflict rules must be covered by automated tests, not manual QA, given their compliance sensitivity.
items.target: At least 95% branch coverage on the state-derivation function and the maker-checker enforcement path.

items.statement: Every lifecycle transition must be observable in telemetry to support operational monitoring of the approval backlog.
items.target: A telemetry event is emitted for every PROPOSED, APPROVED and REJECTED transition, with a metric tracking count of exceptions currently in PENDING state.
